headline: Faster on big projects, a tidier panel, and Download gets you the new version straight away.
notes: Big projects are much quicker in the Project view: long lists show 200 rows at a time, with Show 200 more at the foot
Download in the update banner now downloads the latest Trace+ instead of opening the website
Help and licence's "is available" card has a Download button beside What's new
Pointing at a row shows just Source now – Find has gone from the row, and alt-click still copies the name
The Project view's tour has a new step for the colour and marker bar at the foot of the panel
Colour labels now check every clip they were sent to, not just the first. If some did not take the colour, the status line says so, for example Mango set on 3 of 4 items

In a clip's own view, ticked uses that come from another import of the same file are now coloured too. Ticked uses inside a nest are counted, and the status line explains why the timeline keeps the nest's colour
The colour beside the clip's name updates as soon as you pick one
The scan report now records what each label press did, so a timeline that does not change colour can be traced to its cause
With Clip tags on, the Project view no longer says not used twice – the tag says it. Turn Clip tags off and the words come back

The Select all button has gone from each clip's row in the Active cut view. The tick box at the start of the row does the same job – press it again to untick – and a ticked clip's row is now a lighter grey
The show/hide eye on each row is now off by default. To bring it back, pin Show / hide eye in Filters › Rows
The ☰ menu now sits at the right-hand end of the toolbar instead of on a row of its own, so the list starts one row higher. On a narrow panel the button words make room for it first
